headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with over 50% revenue growth, driven by large AI‑led deals. Mid‑tier players such as LTM, Tech Mahindra and Persistent also posted double‑digit growth. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% after a 1.5% YoY increase, signalling slowing momentum. Most peers highlighted AI contributions, but few disclosed concrete AI revenue figures.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI‑driven revenue, with Infosys reporting a 29% AI revenue rise and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue. TCS highlighted $3.1 bn AI revenue, crossing 10% of total.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and reported a 21% profit jump despite modest top‑line growth. Wipro gave a narrow revenue outlook with flat profit.

themes.title: Mid‑tier expansion
themes.detail: Coforge, Persistent and LTM delivered double‑digit revenue growth, reflecting strong demand in mid‑market and niche services.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
